title: EHR Database Access — Suspicious Admin Logon

fields.rule: Privileged Account Activity — Exfiltration and Deletion During Downtime Window
fields.ruleDescription: An administrator account accessed the EHR database server via VPN during the downtime window, followed by large data transfer and deletion of the on-site backup repository.

details.value: Down — No access to database or interface engine

fields.rawEvent:
2026-03-03T02:09:03Z ORRMC-SQL01 Windows Event Log 4624: User 'svc-ehr-admin' logged on via VPN from IP 198.51.100.44. MFA push approved at 02:09:03.
2026-03-03T02:15:11Z ORRMC-SQL01 File System Event 4663: Access to 380 GB of EHR data (path: C:\\EHR\\Data\\DB01) initiated by svc-ehr-admin.
2026-03-03T05:12:44Z ORRMC-BKP01 File System Event 4663: Delete operation on 380 GB of EHR data (backup volume BKP01-03) initiated by IP 198.51.100.44.
2026-03-03T05:14:22Z ORRMC-SQL01 File System Event 4663: File encryption started on ORRMC-SQL01 and ORRMC-SQL02 (total 2.1 TB).

relatedAlerts.title: EHR Database Servers Unreachable — Ransom Note Found

instructorNote: This inject confirms the intrusion window and data exfiltration. The ISO must isolate the EHR environment and activate EOP Level 1. Watch for whether the AOC invokes crisis standards of care.
